title: Research: group D native residual widths under #2979 joint W (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and scope

Bounded independent-moment audit under priority revision 6 for #2979 group D. Leave-alone [#3411](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3411) binds group B (`0:260` / `114:260`); [#3436](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3436) binds group C (`115:262`); group A entrance binds `0:261` / `115:261`.

This package binds group D helpers `{454,455,556,557}` under shared `W=⟨256,128,64,37,21,8,3⟩` on both providers and both orientations:

- all four helpers: residual pair `114:263`, entrance `[51]`, width **6**
- adapter and `LOCAL-CHECKS` hashes match retained `FULL-NATIVE-RECEIPT.json`
- widths join all **2664** T74 fill placements

**Scoped native/interface audit. No new kappa.** Selected κ stays 0.001672660197076918. Guide margins `+17170` / single-helper negatives are deliberately not headlined (already in `#2979` `STAGE-PRICES.json`).

## Result

Package: `research/rank7-group-d-native-widths-audit/`.
Tip: `5cb6f0e4ddd25370f736d1498585573eb43092c9`.
Content tip: `79cfa71e44968c0d6f5ca5df92a038aea12e354a`.
Base: `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/rank7-group-d-native-widths-audit/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/rank7-group-d-native-widths-audit/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/rank7-group-d-native-widths-audit/test_verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank7-group-d-native-widths-audit
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_GROUP_D_NATIVE_WIDTHS providers=2 helpers=4 residual_widths=6,6,6,6 pairs=454:114:263,455:114:263,556:114:263,557:114:263 placements=2664 adapter_pinned both_orientations no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/rank7-group-d-native-widths-audit outcome=partial
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` / `require()` and still fires under `-O`.

## Overlap and credit

Closest priors: [#3411](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3411), [#3436](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3436), group-A entrance (native method; different helpers/W/pairs); #2979 `research/rank7-joint-endframes/` @ `be191346…`. Does not reopen #3421, #3392, #3386, #3374, #3349, deferred V45 / rho=0 / group-B margins, or the merged readout series through #2883.
